name: 15627 · Derry, PA
findings: ZIP 15627 (Derry) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15627 (Derry) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
